video_title: Has LeBron James unintentionally lost VJ MILLIONS 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the need for VJ Edgecombe to take clutch shots
quotes.excerpt: VJ is going to have to take those shots. So you have to install that confidence in him
quotes.quote: The situation is going to be where VJ Edgecombe is going to have to take those shots. So you have to install that confidence in him during the season. You cannot make him just go sit in the corner all year because you have all these guys. You still have to win with a team. LeBron James has the ball down in the stretch, he is going to get double-teamed. He is going to make the right pass. We know that about LeBron. And guess who is going to be the obvious guy open with all those guys? VJ Edgecombe. So he is going to be the guy that is going to have to make the shot.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Raymond Felton debate VJ Edgecombe's role as a shooter
quotes.excerpt: At the end of the game to make a shot, VJ Edgecombe or a shooter like Kentavious Caldwell-Pope

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: At the end of the game to make a shot, VJ Edgecombe or a shooter like Kentavious Caldwell-Pope.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Why is it going to be an issue though? I like VJ Edgecombe. I think he can make shots.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: If we are talking about catch and shoot, Ray, he is more established.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on VJ Edgecombe accepting a new role
quotes.excerpt: He just got to accept another role. He needs to call J.R. Smith and call Jamal Crawford
quotes.quote: He just got to accept another role. He needs to call J.R. Smith and call Jamal Crawford and just talk to them about their role. You know what I am saying? Because think about J.R., think about J.R.'s talent. J.R. went from New York to being a sixth man. How he played in Cleveland, he hit the rest of the shots. I used to ask him, I used to call him and be like, 'Son, you forgot how to dribble?' He would be like, 'I get it,' and he would throw it off the backboard. But he bought into his role.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Sixers needing to define VJ Edgecombe's role
quotes.excerpt: They need to go to him and be like, 'Look VJ, we had the opportunity, we had to take advantage'
quotes.quote: The Sixers need to come to them and just like Al said, they need to go to him and be like, 'Look VJ, we had the opportunity, we had to take advantage of the opportunity. You are going to get your bread.' Because I do not want the, we know how this league can be. If he is great at this role, they will keep him at that role. If he is a great slasher, great defender, hits capable, they are going to be like, 'No, you good at this. You do not need to do no more.' That is what I do not want for him for it to happen.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on VJ Edgecombe's long-term potential
quotes.excerpt: I personally think long-term he is a three. He is like the third best guy
quotes.quote: I do not think he is a one. I personally think long-term he is a three. He is like the third best guy. He is definitely not like, he does not have the talent of being the guy. You understand what I am saying? So I think I agree with you like I think he can slide into whatever role it is, but you are right because the league will do that to you fast. They will make you a player that you like, 'This is the hard part though, pause.'

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Joel Embiid's health being the key for the Sixers
quotes.excerpt: If Joel Embiid is in shape and available, then they really have a chance to win this shit
quotes.quote: He is obviously the cherry on the top to this whole shit. Because if Joel Embiid comes in in shape and available, then they really have a chance to win this shit. But I also think this is motivating him though. You bring in LeBron James and you bring in J.R. Smith, this is motivating him to like, 'I got to get in shape, I got to get healthy.'

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Sixers being a top-tier team
quotes.excerpt: It is going to be hard for you to show me a better five than that
quotes.quote: I do not give a damn what nobody says. It is going to be hard for you to show me a better five than that. There is none. You got to show me a better five. There is none.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Max Strus and Peyton Watson trade
quotes.excerpt: Peyton Watson has been traded to the Cleveland Cavaliers from the Denver Nuggets
quotes.quote: There was a big-time trade yesterday. Peyton Watson has been traded to the Cleveland Cavaliers from the Denver Nuggets. The Denver Nuggets got back some picks, I believe, and Max Strus is headed to LA.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on James Harden's defensive liabilities
quotes.excerpt: Anytime he shot the basketball, his the person that was defending him got a layup on the other end
quotes.quote: My only problem with James Harden in that series was that anytime he shot the basketball, his the person that was defending him got a layup on the other end. Because he is like just standing there or he will follow his shot. So my my thing with that is, I am just like, what do you do with that? Like as a coach, as an organization, what do you do with that?
